title: JAM:Just Another Modpack
description: A mostly QOL and general use modpack with many useful features!
body:
Just another modpack for general use. Contains all well-known mods. With some not so well-known mods as well.

**QOL**

In terms of useful features, The **modpack** has more of them tham most other modpacks.Basically anything you want to do can be done.

**Performance**

The modpack is designed as more of a general use and QOL modpack rather than a performance one, even hugely popular mods like Lithium are excluded.So,if you are looking for pure performance then this is not it,but if you want the most customization and an overall great experience while playing game then this is it!

**Best Features:**

As stated before this is a mostly QOL modpack with many useful features. This is a list of some of the best.

**•** Execute any command with any keypress

**•** Connect to a server running on a older version from a modern version

**•** Easily switch accounts

**•** Be able to easily view the contents of a shulker box

**•** Be able to quickly build using Litematic

Hope you enjoy the modpack!

 TheRandomedOne
